b'# tinydl - Simple CLI Downloader

tinydl is a minimal command-line tool to download a URL and write the content to a file or stdout.

## Usage

```
tinydl <URL> [--options]
```

## Options

- `url` (positional) - what to download
- `-o`, `--output` - file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet` - no progress output (store_true flag)

## Example

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -o file.txt
tinydl https://example.com/image.png --quiet
```
'
